description: Find open EU public tenders a company could bid on. Searches TED (Official Journal S) for open EU/EEA procurement notices by keywords, CPV codes, buyer countries and minimum days to deadline. Returns notice ID, title, buyer, country, CPV, deadline, estimated value, procedure and links, newest first. Use when building a bid pipeline or sales leads from public procurement. $0.03 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.
